hero.title: Help us build PLACER
hero.subtitle: Five questions about how you run community engagement today, and what would actually help. It takes about three minutes, and it shapes what we build next.

steps.emailDescription: Want to follow our progress or join the closed beta? This part is optional.

section2.label: Which digital tools do you currently rely on most for community engagement?

options.label: Spatial & GIS Platforms: Maptionnaire, Felt, ArcGIS, etc.
Visual Collaboration Boards: Miro, Mural, Figma, etc.
Standard Survey Tools: Typeform, Google Forms, SurveyMonkey, etc.
Social & Messaging Channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Groups, etc.
Custom / Proprietary Software: In-house or specialized municipal platforms

section2.label: What are your biggest challenges in placemaking?

options.label: Demographic Reach
options.description: Reaching diverse ages, online and in person

options.label: Data Structuring
options.description: Turning sticky notes and comments into GIS data

options.label: Visual Communication
options.description: Helping non-experts read complex 2D and 3D plans

options.label: Conflict Resolution
options.description: Navigating opposing views between stakeholder groups

options.label: Sustaining Momentum
options.description: Keeping residents engaged over long timelines

options.label: Executive Buy-in
options.description: Reports that convince councils and decision-makers

options.label: Resource Limits
options.description: No budget or technical setup for custom tools

section3.label: What would you love to see in PLACER?

options.label: Instant PDF summary reports for city councils
Cobudgeting: allocating a real budget together

section3.label: How would you like to participate in co-creating PLACER?

options.label: Just by submitting this survey (No further commitment required)
Testing early prototypes and providing feedback
Joining a 15-minute interview to share specific workflow needs
Submitting a real project as a test case study
